title: Results of the fourth population census in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, December 1859
descriptions: The dataset is based on the population census of the Netherlands of 1859 published in 5 vols. Content: images of the publication, searchable pdf files of the text sections and excel files with data entered from the published tables.
